metadata.rules_text:
- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.7) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 5–10% for next 3–5 days.  
- After sharp price spikes (≥ 10% from prior peak), model often overshoots; cap forecast at +5% above peak for 2–3 days.  
- If sentiment turns negative (≤ -0.5) after a rally, model fails to correct; reduce forecast by 10–15% for 3–7 days.  
- Model consistently overestimates mean price in 30-day horizon; apply 3–5% downward bias for long-term forecasts.  
- If sentiment history shows alternating highs/lows (e.g., +0.7, -0.5, +0.7), model misreads momentum; use 2-day moving average of sentiment to adjust forecast direction.  
- When true outcome deviates >10% from 14-day moving average, model is lagging; add 1–2% upward bias for next 3 days if sentiment is neutral or positive.
